caseNameFull: Henry F. Mueller v. Samuel W. Adler
attorneys: Mr. Otto A. Schlobohm, Mr. Wm. J. Hughes and Mr. Ephrim Capian for appellants., Mr. Edward W. Foristel for appellees.

opinions.text: On consideration of the petition for a rehearing or to remand this cause to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, it is ordered by the Court that said cause be, and the same is hereby, transferred to the said Circuit Court of Appeals, pursuant to the Act of Congress of September 14, 1922.
